characters.description: The leader who upholds Li Yi Nuo's assigned mission while rebuking the elders for placing her in needless danger. His intervention compels them to elevate her as the sect's young mistress and provide resources for her task.
characters.name: Sect patriarch

characters.description: The public epithet used for Sen by townspeople who know him as a charitable cultivator. Li Yi Nuo recognizes the blue-robed benefactor bearing this name as the cultivator tracked by her compass.
characters.name: Judgment's Gale

characters.description: Li Yi Nuo's former friend and fellow outer disciple, killed by a dual cultivator connected to a rival sect. Her death drives Li Yi Nuo to seek practical instruction against dual cultivators after internal politics prevent her own sect from supporting the pursuit of vengeance.
characters.name: Xia

characters.description: A powerful, many-tailed spirit fox who can change shape and create illusions. An old associate of Feng Ming, he addresses Sen as a junior brother and invokes a dangerous favor Sen owes him, insisting that Li Yi Nuo come along.
characters.name: Laughing River

characters.description: An androgynous fox cultivator determined to stop Laughing River from obtaining the object he seeks. The infiltrator hides both body and surroundings beneath layered illusions, defeats Sen after he begins countering the deception, drugs him, and leaves to attack Laughing River.
characters.name: Fox infiltrator

characters.description: Laughing River's descendant and the fox infiltrator who drugged Sen, wounded her grandfather, and abducted Li Yi Nuo. She opposes Laughing River's attempt to claim the ruins treasure, while her strong concealment and illusion craft make both pursuit and direct confrontation difficult.
characters.name: Misty Peak

characters.description: Sen's Ghost Panther family and companion from earlier volumes. Her inability to freely return to panther form remains an important unresolved concern, and Sen regards her safety and future as personal obligations rather than matters he can leave to chance.
characters.name: Falling Leaf

characters.description: The leader of a spider brood living near the temple ruins. Aware that Sen has killed spiders before, she accepts a narrow non-aggression agreement under which he stays near the cleared ruins and later departs toward the road while her brood observes without interfering.
characters.name: Spider matriarch

characters.description: An individual spider from the local matriarch's brood whom Sen protects from a fire eagle. After Sen retrieves the eagle's remains and returns to his shelter, this spider stays outside when the rest of its escort leaves.
characters.name: Saved spider watcher

characters.description: An ancient monk who oversees the temple at the center of the city's mandala. He tells Sen that every traveller must finish an individual path before reuniting with the others, explains that the defenses test whether Laughing River is ready to ascend, and agrees to provide the spatial treasure.
characters.name: Temple caretaker

characters.description: The spider spirit beast Sen saved from a fire eagle, now identified on his separate mandala path. He regards Sen as a benefactor, follows the path set before him instead of taking tempting branches, and meets a distant transcendent ancestor who intends to choose boons for him.
characters.name: Glimmer of Night

characters.description: A celestial-scale ancestor who receives Glimmer of Night at the end of his cosmic web-like mandala path. She treats him as one of her distant children and, after he declines to request any reward, decides that she will select suitable boons for him herself.
characters.name: Transcendent spider matriarch

characters.description: A spear-wielding devil directing the horde's pursuit as Sen's party leaves the ruins. It is physically stronger than Sen, intelligent enough to single him out, and violently hostile to living creatures and divine power. Its first spear strike leaves devilish qi in Sen's chest.
characters.name: Intelligent red-eyed devil

characters.description: A child previously given a qi-marked necklace by Sen. Her extreme fear reaches him through that lingering connection after her village is burned. Sen follows the signal to a remote camp and finds her caged with other survivors, making their rescue his immediate priority.
characters.name: Orphaned village girl

characters.description: One of Sen's established teachers from earlier volumes. Feng Ming remains part of the formidable circle of mentors whose instruction shaped Sen before this volume.
characters.name: Feng Ming

characters.description: An established cultivator from Sen's earlier travels, distinct from Feng Ming.
characters.name: Feng

characters.description: A returning elder and protector whom Sen addresses as his uncle. Kho belongs to the small circle Sen treats as family and trusts more deeply than any sect or institution, making him one of the established personal bonds carried into this volume.
characters.name: Kho

characters.description: Sen's established spear teacher from earlier volumes and one of the formidable cultivators responsible for his martial education. Jaw-Long remains part of Sen's trusted circle and a major influence on the spear skills Sen carries into this volume.
characters.name: Jaw-Long

characters.description: A returning master alchemist, Jaw-Long's wife, and an established alchemical mentor to Sen.
characters.name: Caihong

characters.description: A powerful returning alchemist whose secluded domain shelters Falling Leaf. The cultivator is an established patron and alchemical mentor to Sen.
characters.name: Nascent-soul cultivator

recaps.ending: Sen leaves the temple-city with its spatial treasure, accompanied by Misty Peak and the newly transformed Glimmer of Night. He survives the horde's ambush and an intelligent devil's attacks, then uses a dangerous divine-qi elixir to remove the devilish corruption from his wounds. The horde disperses, but the party cannot find the red-eyed devil's body. Li Yi Nuo returns to the Vermilion Blade Sect with Sen's elixirs and his letter of introduction to Jaw-Long. Her master accepts the peace offering and ends the sect's pursuit of Judgment's Gale, although the three afflicted disciples and Li Yi Nuo's vengeance for Xia remain unresolved. Sen holds Laughing River's treasure until the fox teaches Falling Leaf to change form. While travelling onward with Glimmer, Sen rescues captives from a raiding camp and assumes responsibility for an orphaned village girl. The nascent-soul cultivator grants her temporary refuge. Sen, Glimmer, Falling Leaf, and the girl finish the volume together in that domain, while Sen's altered cultivation, Laughing River's delayed ascension, the fox massacre dispute, the missing devil, and the child's permanent future remain open.
recaps.in_short: Sen travels toward Falling Leaf but is drawn into Laughing River's attempt to recover a time-space treasure from a holy city surrounded by a devilish horde. Li Yi Nuo, sent by the Vermilion Blade Sect to capture Sen, becomes entangled in the expedition, while Laughing River's descendant Misty Peak tries to stop him. An involuntary heavenly-qi breakthrough pushes Sen into late core formation and leaves unexplained divine qi within his body. Sen, Misty Peak, and the spider Glimmer of Night enter the ruins, complete separate mandala trials, and obtain the treasure. Their escape becomes a brutal battle with the horde and an intelligent red-eyed devil. Sen survives severe wounds and purges devilish qi with an improvised elixir, but the devil's body is not found. Li Yi Nuo persuades her sect to end its pursuit. Sen and Glimmer then rescue survivors of a destroyed village, and Sen brings an orphaned girl to the nascent-soul cultivator's domain for temporary safety.

recaps.text: Previously: Sen became an independent spirit-and-body cultivator trained by several formidable teachers, including Feng Ming and the spear master Jaw-Long. He counts Kho as an uncle, studies alchemy within Caihong's circle of expertise, and has learned to distrust sects and other powerful institutions. Falling Leaf, a Ghost Panther who is family to him, remains unable to freely return to her original form and is staying in a powerful nascent-soul cultivator's domain. Sen also owes the ancient fox Laughing River a favor.

So far this book: Li Yi Nuo cares for three sect disciples trapped in unbearable mental and emotional torment. A hostile elder orders her to find the unknown cultivator responsible, but her master kills that elder and warns the rest of the leadership against sacrificing her. Elsewhere, Sen befriends a ship's crew and refuses to abandon them when a powerful sea spirit beast attacks. He kills it after a difficult battle, diverts a huge wave around the ship with an extraordinary water technique, and suffers both severe wounds and an unfamiliar exhaustion. After recovering, he strengthens the ship with formations and leaves its grateful captain with funds to expand his trade. At Elder Bo's cove, Sen learns that divine qi has changed his Five-Fold Body Transformation into an uncertain sixth stage. Their argument becomes a brief, one-sided fight that exposes a weakness in Sen's unarmed methods. Elder Bo then explains that divine qi has strengthened the link between Sen's body and mortal soul. The desperate exertion used to save the ship may have strained that soul, so Sen must avoid forcing the same power without any reliable way to measure the damage. He leaves the cove and resumes his journey toward Falling Leaf.

Li Yi Nuo tracks Sen and discovers that the feared technique-user is also the charitable cultivator called Judgment's Gale. Sen admits afflicting the three disciples after they attacked him, but refuses to return to a sect he expects will try to kill him. Li Yi Nuo attacks to fulfill her mission. Sen defeats her, returns her weapon, treats her injuries, and later hears that her deeper goal is vengeance for Xia, a friend killed by a rival dual cultivator. He refuses to train Li Yi Nuo because his hostility toward sects could distort that relationship, but gives her a confidential introduction to Jaw-Long and a message for Kho. Before they separate, the spirit fox Laughing River invokes a favor Sen owes him and forces Li Yi Nuo to accompany them into the wilds. He says they must recover an old treasure but withholds practical details. Sen expects manipulation and danger, while Li Yi Nuo gradually becomes more cooperative with him. Their destination proves to be a sacred temple-city surrounded by an enormous horde of ghosts and devilish creatures. Believing Laughing River wants him to steal from holy ruins and seeing no survivable route through the horde, Sen refuses to continue.

Laughing River admits that foxes cannot enter the temple-city and that he brought Li Yi Nuo partly to make Sen less willing to walk away. When both humans still try to leave, he reveals that he is dying. Laughing River says he gained a ninth tail and should have ascended long ago, but delayed until he lost the strength to complete the passage. A treasure with time-space affinity inside the ruins may restore his chance. Sen personally examines him and confirms widespread decay, though not how much time remains. Li Yi Nuo refuses to be sent away despite lacking battlefield experience, and Sen rejects Laughing River's suggestion that killing her would simplify matters. The group studies the horde and concludes that direct battle and ordinary stealth are both unworkable. Li Yi Nuo identifies the need for a distraction, and Sen designs a vast formation intended to bombard one side of the horde long enough to open a route. Escape remains a separate problem. While placing the first section of formation flags, Sen is approached by a black-robed stranger who can evade his senses. The stranger recognizes Laughing River as a nine-tailed liar and tells Sen to let him die.

The stranger is a fox infiltrator intent on preventing Laughing River from obtaining the treasure. Sen learns to counter the attacker's layered illusions, but the fox drugs him, wounds Laughing River, and abducts Li Yi Nuo. Laughing River identifies the attacker as his descendant Misty Peak. Sen declares that the murder attempt and abduction exceed the favor he owed, then sets new terms: Laughing River must investigate whether Falling Leaf can ever regain or freely change her panther form. As Sen prepares two formation routes and a remotely triggered escape option, Misty Peak confronts him and confirms Li Yi Nuo is alive. She claims Laughing River summoned the continent's fox clans to a gathering near the Mountains of Sorrow, where hundreds were massacred, including her father. Since Laughing River was believed to be the only survivor, she regards him as the betrayer. Sen refuses to accept inherited accusation as proof and points out that Misty Peak herself would demand a chance to answer such a charge. She agrees to provide her full account and hear Laughing River's response. The hostage gives her little leverage because Sen will not surrender his judgment or the mission merely to recover Li Yi Nuo.

Laughing River confirms that he called the fatal fox gathering but denies betraying anyone. He says he rescued about a dozen foxes and withdrew afterward from guilt and grief, leaving the origin of the accusation unresolved. After initially neglecting the search because he dislikes Li Yi Nuo, he captures Misty Peak and confronts her privately. Sen refuses to mediate their family and political dispute. While they talk, he practices his weapons and maintains that he will offer shelter but take no responsibility for fox affairs. His plan to slow his cultivation then fails abruptly when a massive flow of heavenly qi forces another core layer to form. Sen strengthens two internal qi structures and reforges his body, but the energy continues beyond his control. An inaccessible inner gate finally opens and drains the excess somewhere connected to his soul. No expected tribulation follows. Sen wakes with denser qi, a larger core and dantian, and thousands of divine-qi points embedded in his skin. Laughing River judges that he has jumped from middle to late core formation and should not have survived the process. Sen can hide the visible glow, but neither he nor the fox understands its purpose, and Sen cannot reopen the inner channel.

Sen tests the strength and speed gained from his forced advancement and finds that even ordinary movement now requires restraint. Near the ruins, he negotiates a limited peace with the local spider matriarch, who permits his work while her brood watches. Sen later saves one of those watchers from a fire eagle. The spider begins guarding his shelter, apparently accepting a personal debt despite fearing him. Misty Peak asks to join the ruins expedition. Sen agrees only if Laughing River permits it, she can independently cross the anti-fox barrier, and she accepts responsibility for her own survival. Laughing River gives permission, while Misty Peak releases Li Yi Nuo from captivity. Sen completes and tests paired fire and lightning formations meant to pull part of the horde away from their chosen approach. The spider watcher stays beside him throughout the work, and the wider brood's surveillance becomes less tense. Sen still expects a fight because the distraction cannot draw every enemy away. After warning Li Yi Nuo, Misty Peak, and Laughing River that further personal conflict will make him abandon the plan, he finishes the final adjustments. The attempt to enter the ruins is set for dawn.

At dawn, Sen activates the fire and lightning formations while Laughing River adds an illusory army. Li Yi Nuo remains behind, but the saved spider unexpectedly follows Sen and Misty Peak toward the thinning edge of the horde. A spirit tries to possess Sen, and the divine qi in his skin destroys it. Rather than unleash an attack that might damage the sacred city, Sen spreads Heaven's Shadow through part of the horde, driving enemies into terror and conflict with one another. He then uses divine qi, lightning, and wind to force open a route. Sen, Misty Peak, and the spider cross the protective barrier, where a bell-like effect ends the immediate pursuit and strips away Misty Peak's human disguise. The city within is intact yet deliberately empty, with homes and durable possessions left behind. Their objective remains the spatial treasure Laughing River needs, and the central temple appears the likeliest location. However, a planted marker proves that the party's seemingly direct movement is being redirected without any detectable illusion. From above, Sen sees that the city is much larger than it appeared and that their route traces a deliberate pattern. He identifies the entire city as a mandala that has trapped them.

The sun does not move inside the ruins, and every attempt to retreat, fly directly to the temple, or escape the mandala returns the group to its imposed route. As they proceed, each traveller enters a separate trial. Sen's endless mountain ascent forces him to confront his regrets and accept that compassion and ruthlessness are both genuine parts of him. At the temple he meets an ancient caretaker, who explains that the city's defenses were designed to test Laughing River's readiness to ascend. The caretaker gives Sen the spatial treasure. On another path, the spider meets a transcendent matriarch, who grants him a humanoid form and the name Glimmer of Night so he can communicate. She directs him to travel with Sen for centuries. Misty Peak reports a similar instruction from fox ancestors. The caretaker says the absent inhabitants will eventually return and that the surrounding horde is contained because destroying it would cause equivalent evil to emerge elsewhere. The three travellers complete the mandala, but no one can determine how much outside time has passed. At the barrier, Sen discovers his remote formation trigger no longer works. Glimmer instead learns to crack beast cores so they detonate when thrown. The group prepares these as distractions, and Sen crosses the barrier first to begin their escape.

Sen opens the escape with Heaven's Shadow, cracked beast cores, darkness, lightning, and divine qi. Misty Peak warns Laughing River while Glimmer joins the bombardment. The horde has anticipated their exit, and an intelligent red-eyed devil attacks Sen with a spear. It is stronger than him and repeatedly drives devilish qi into severe chest wounds. Sen destroys part of its weapon and removes part of one arm, but he is blinded, deafened in one ear, poisoned, and eventually impaled. As the horde closes around him, he feeds divine qi into a damaged Stormhawk core. The devil's strike triggers a violent ground-level storm resembling a tribulation, scattering the horde. Glimmer rescues the incapacitated Sen, and Misty Peak guides the retreat to the gale house. After resting, Sen improvises a divine-qi elixir to purge the devilish corruption. The treatment nearly kills him and damages the shelter, but it removes the hostile qi and repairs his injuries. Once recovered, Sen confirms Glimmer still intends to travel with him and allows Misty Peak to accompany Laughing River's route only. Sen and Laughing River search the battlefield but find no body belonging to the red-eyed devil, leaving its survival unresolved.

Li Yi Nuo leaves the group near the Vermilion Blade Sect and reports her defeat, capture, the ruins expedition, Sen's battle with the horde, and his survival of the divine-qi elixir. She delivers Sen's elixirs and his introduction to Jaw-Long. Recognizing Sen's connections to Jaw-Long and Caihong, her master accepts the peace offering and ends the sect's pursuit of Judgment's Gale. Sen later leaves Misty Peak and Laughing River near Falling Leaf's destination but holds the spatial treasure until the fox teaches Falling Leaf to change form. Travelling with Glimmer, Sen senses an urgent call through a qi imprint on a necklace he once made for a village girl. They find her village burned and follow the surviving captives to a remote encampment. Sen kills the armed attackers and their leader but spares some others, while Glimmer protects the prisoners. They free the villagers and return recovered wealth to a surviving elder. The girl repeatedly leaves a resettlement village to find Sen, so he accepts immediate responsibility for her. Sen and Glimmer carry her through the wilds to the nascent-soul cultivator's domain. The cultivator grants her temporary refuge alongside Sen, Glimmer, and Falling Leaf, while Sen continues seeking a permanent home for her.

characters.description: The fourth of the nine and the last narrator of the series. He is grieving Sarah, commanding an alliance he never asked to lead, and out of patience with anything that is not the end of the war. His Legacies are the broadest of any Garde and still growing. What he will not discuss is what he intends to spend to finish this, or that he has stopped assuming he will be alive when it is over.
characters.name: John Smith

characters.description: The sixth of the nine, invisible when she chooses and able to call down weather, and the most capable soldier the Loric have. With human forces and newly powered human teenagers joining the war, she becomes one of the people responsible for turning them into something that can fight rather than simply die bravely.
characters.name: Number Six

characters.description: The seventh of the nine, healer and one of the group's deadliest fighters, carrying a Legacy of lethal cold that came out of grief. She has been hardened by every book since Spain, and the war's last phase asks her to keep people alive faster than the Mogadorians can kill them.
characters.name: Marina

characters.description: The ninth of the nine, strong, fast, and able to move along any surface. He has spent the series wanting a straight fight against the Mogadorians and now has one, and he turns out to be better with the new human Garde than anyone expected him to be.
characters.name: Number Nine

characters.description: The youngest Garde, whose Legacies work on minds and dreams. Setrakus Ra's claim on her as his granddaughter and heir has left a connection between them that she cannot simply refuse, and it makes her both the Garde's best source on him and their most dangerous vulnerability.
characters.name: Ella

characters.description: The Mogadorian who broke with his own people, carrying the memories of Number One and an earth-shaking Legacy. He fights alongside the Garde against the species he was born into, and the intelligence he brings about Mogadorian command, ships, and doctrine is what makes an offensive possible at all.
characters.name: Adam

characters.description: John's human friend since Paradise, now with a Legacy of his own for reaching machines. He has been in this war longer than anyone except John and is no longer the person who has to be protected during it.
characters.name: Sam Goode

characters.description: Sam's father, whose memories of the Loric arrival on Earth have shaped every advantage the Garde have found. He works the research and liaison side of an alliance that now includes human governments and militaries.
characters.name: Malcolm Goode

characters.description: The fifth of the nine, who killed Number Eight, fought for the Mogadorians, and is held responsible by John for Sarah Hart's death. He can fly and take on the properties of anything he touches, and he knows both sides of this war from the inside, which is the only reason anyone considers what he has to say.
characters.name: Number Five

characters.description: The Mogadorian leader, who destroyed Lorien, hunted the nine across Earth, and now occupies its cities openly. He is not killable by any means the Garde have tried, and the claim he made on Ella has tied the two of them together in a way that makes striking at him dangerous to her.
characters.name: Setrakus Ra

characters.description: The Chimaera who has guarded John since Lorien, taking whatever animal shape a fight requires. He has been with John longer than any other survivor of their world.
characters.name: Bernie Kosar

recaps.ending: The war ends with Setrakus Ra dead and John Smith dead with him. Ordinary force could not kill the Mogadorian leader, and the link he forged with Ella meant that any attempt risked killing her too. John, whose Legacies had grown to include taking on the powers he sees others use, is the one who finds a way through and spends his own life doing it. The Mogadorian occupation collapses without him. Ella survives, freed from the claim he made on her. Six, Marina, Nine, Sam, Adam, and Malcolm survive, along with the human Garde whose Legacies the sanctuary released. A year later the surviving Loric have turned the aftermath into an institution: an academy where human teenagers with Legacies are gathered, taught, and kept from being used as weapons by their own governments, run by the Garde who fought the war. The Loric survivors are no longer the last of anything, because the Legacies they carried have passed into humanity, and Earth ends the series with a generation of people who can do what the nine could and a peace that has to be managed rather than won.
recaps.in_short: The final book turns the Garde's survival into an offensive. Working with human militaries and with the newly powered human Garde created when the sanctuary released Legacies into humanity, the surviving Loric go after the Mogadorian occupation city by city. Number Five surrenders and is imprisoned, offering intelligence on Setrakus Ra that the Garde need and John cannot forgive him enough to want. The obstacle is Setrakus Ra himself: nothing they have kills him, and the claim he made on Ella as his granddaughter has bound her life to his, so striking at him endangers her. John's Legacies expand until he can take on powers he watches other people use, and in the final assault he uses everything he has to destroy Setrakus Ra, dying in the act. The occupation collapses. Ella is freed, Six, Marina, Nine, Sam, Adam, and Malcolm survive, and a year later the survivors open an academy for the human teenagers whose Legacies the war produced.

recaps.text: Nine Loric children were sent to Earth with guardians called Cepans when the Mogadorians destroyed Lorien. Numbers One, Two, and Three were killed before the survivors ever met; every Cepan is dead, including Henri, who raised Number Four, John Smith. The survivors found each other one by one: Six, Seven (Marina), Eight, Nine, and Ten (Ella, from a second Loric ship), with John's human friend Sam Goode, Sam's father Malcolm, Sarah Hart, and the Chimaera Bernie Kosar. Number Five was found last and had already gone over to the Mogadorians; he killed Number Eight, and Marina took one of his eyes with a Legacy of lethal cold. Setrakus Ra captured Ella and told her she is his granddaughter and intended heir. Adam, a Mogadorian carrying the memories of Number One, defected and helped expose the enemy's plan to approach humanity openly. Setrakus Ra did so, then his fleet decloaked and the invasion began. In Mexico a surviving Loric presence released Legacies into ordinary humans worldwide; in New York Sarah Hart was killed, and John blames Five. Four of the nine are alive and free, one fights for the enemy, and Earth is occupied.

The Garde stop operating as fugitives and start operating as part of an alliance. Human governments and militaries, having watched their own forces fail against Mogadorian ships, accept Loric help, and the newly powered human teenagers appearing all over the world are being gathered rather than left to work it out alone. John leads without wanting to, grieving Sarah and increasingly unwilling to hear any plan that ends in anything except Setrakus Ra's death. Six, Marina, Nine, Adam, Sam, and Malcolm each take on a part of the effort, from training human Garde to reading the Mogadorian order of battle. The occupation itself is entrenched: the Mogadorians hold ground in cities across the planet and can reinforce from orbit, and no counterattack yet attempted has held anything for long.

Number Five gives himself up to the Garde. He is imprisoned rather than executed, over John's objections, because what he knows about Setrakus Ra, the fleet, and the Mogadorian command is not available anywhere else. Nobody in the group trusts a word of it, and everybody uses it. For John the arrangement is intolerable: Five killed Number Eight and John holds him responsible for Sarah, and he has to work with the intelligence anyway. Meanwhile Ella's connection to Setrakus Ra persists even at a distance, which makes her the Garde's best window into what he intends and a standing risk to every plan they make in her presence.

The alliance goes onto the offensive, retaking ground and hitting Mogadorian positions with a mix of human forces, Loric Garde, and the human Garde whose Legacies arrived weeks ago and who are being sent into combat with almost no training. The victories are real and expensive. Adam's knowledge of Mogadorian ships and command structures shapes the campaign, and Sam's ability to reach machines becomes a weapon in its own right. Throughout, the strategic problem stays unsolved: every Mogadorian position can be taken, and none of it matters while Setrakus Ra is alive, because he cannot be killed by anything the Garde have brought against him.

The Garde work out the shape of the problem they have been avoiding. Setrakus Ra survives injuries that would kill anything else, and the claim he made on Ella has left the two of them connected, so that harming him may kill her. Any plan that ends the war therefore has to solve both at once, and the only person developing fast enough to attempt it is John, whose Legacies have kept expanding until he can take on powers he watches other people use. He does not tell the others what that is likely to cost. The alliance commits to a final assault on Setrakus Ra himself rather than continuing to fight the occupation position by position.

The final assault reaches Setrakus Ra. The fighting costs the alliance heavily, and the Garde and human Garde together are able to bring the Mogadorian leader within reach but not to kill him. John, carrying more Legacies than any of them, breaks the link that protected him and destroys him, and dies doing it. Ella survives, released from the claim Setrakus Ra made on her. With their leader dead, the Mogadorian occupation collapses and the invasion ends. Six, Marina, Nine, Sam, Adam, and Malcolm survive, and so do the human Garde. What the survivors are left with is a planet full of people who now have Legacies, a war won at the cost of the person who held them together, and the question of what happens to the powers Lorien gave away.
